historySource.indexText: On March 27, 1814, at the “horseshoe bend” on the Tallapoosa River, Gen. Andrew Jackson’s forces broke the power of the Upper Creek Indian Confederacy and opened large parts of Alabama and Georgia to settlement. Authorized July 25, 1956.
